sentences: The frog is from the pond.
passage:
Dom is lost. 
He went to look at a frog and lost his mum. 
He can not spot his mum. 
Is Mum at the camp? No.

Mum is not at the camp. 
Is Mum in the sandpit? No.
Mum is not in the sandpit. 
Dom stops at the pond. 
He can see his mum!

He runs to his mum. 
Dom and his mum look at frogs in the pond.
